items.detail: (a) tests/test_xml_specs.py:1509-1545 (documented_migration_example/resolving_example/test_the_documented_migration_example_validates) extracts the fenced ```xml REQ-MIG-1 block from docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md, substitutes the four illustrative paths, and runs auger spec validate; I reproduced it via the real CLI: rc 0, stdout 'spec: 1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok'. (b) docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md:81 states the rule in one sentence ('The `verifies` edge is declared on ONE side of a pair ... declaring both for the same pair is a cycle') and quotes the refusal 'spec error (reference-cycle): REQ-MIG-1 -> TEST-MIG-1 -> REQ-MIG-1' (rc 2); test_a_mutual_verifies_pair_is_the_refusal_the_document_quotes (tests/test_xml_specs.py:1548-1573) pins the rule sentence, the exactly-once quote, and asserts the loader's live stderr contains the quoted text for the mutual variant — I built the mutual variant myself and got rc 2 with exactly that stderr. (c) The loader was NOT changed to accept the mutual shape: the cycle detector (_spec_refuse_reference_cycles, auger.py:8608-8638, raising at :8634) still refuses it, so the conditional clause is satisfied by agreement — doc and code agree, proven by the passing pin test. Test evidence: 'python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q' exit 0, '61 passed in 2.09s'; the file is in the repo gate battery (tests/gate.sh:218).

items.criterion: Corpus copy agreement: corpora/auger-docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.xml (the corpus copy of the doc) carries the same one-side example and rule text, so the two copies cannot drift.
items.detail: git diff HEAD~2 on corpora/auger-docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.xml (commit 534ccf1) shows the same fix applied to the corpus copy: spec id renamed EXAMPLE -> EXAMPLE-MIGRATION, the verification's verifies="REQ-MIG-1" removed, and the one-side rule paragraph with the quoted refusal added (now line 81 of that file). Both copies agree.

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
doc = pathlib.Path("docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md").read_text()
blocks = re.findall(r"```xml[ \t]*\n(.*?)```", doc, re.S)
matches = [b for b in blocks if 'id="REQ-MIG-1"' in b]
print("fenced REQ-MIG-1 blocks:", len(matches))
ex = matches[0]
subs = {
 'path="tests/test_migrations.py"': 'path="tests/test_xml_specs.py"',
 'selector="test_marker_migration"': 'selector="test_migration_obligation_applies_named_file_and_detects_noop"',
 'migration="migrations/001_marker.sql"': 'migration="tests/fixtures/xml/verification/migrations/001_add_marker.sql"',
 'fixture="tests/fixtures/prior_schema.sql"': 'fixture="tests/fixtures/xml/verification/prior_schema.sql"',
}
for k,v in subs.items():
    assert k in ex, k
    ex = ex.replace(k,v)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = pathlib.Path(d)/"example.xml"; p.write_text(ex)
    r = subprocess.run(["python3","auger.py","spec","validate",d,"--repo-root","."],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print("rc:",r.returncode); print("stdout:",r.stdout.strip()); print("stderr:",r.stderr.strip())
EOF
